title: 32 GB graphics cards
evidence: L2x (O121): Qwen3.5 9B, 4-bit QLoRA at 16K, as the 24 GB recipe, measured on an RTX 5090 (this tier's own card: 32 GB, also driving the display): three passes on 90 rows, 69 steps at 8.14 s/step, 20,018 MiB on the card at its peak with room to spare, 29.5 GB of the computer's commit (Windows), gradient norms 0.12-2.3, loss 0.15 over the last ten steps, no spill; the last pass ready in Row-Bot's own server in 218 s. Its need (20,480 MiB free on the card, 30.5 GB of commit) fits any 32 GB card with the display's share. 16-bit LoRA also trains here (7.8 s/step, 26,401 MiB on the card at its peak, 35.9 GB of commit, no spill) but needs 26,880 MiB free; whether 32 GB cards use it where they have that free is decided from night-time free-memory samples. Qwen3.8 27B needs a card with nothing else on it: not certified for 5.4 (O107).
